scope: definitional only — resolves an ambiguity, changes no threshold and no procedure
ordering_evidence: C3_STAGE3_ANCHOR_RESULTS.jsonl does not exist; Stage 1 is still running and no sampled Stage-3 run has been launched

ambiguity.why_it_matters: q_0.025 < q_0.05, so requiring q_0.025 > 0.20 is a strictly harder gate to clear. These are not the same test.

resolution.definition: the 2.5th percentile of the bootstrap distribution, i.e. the lower endpoint of a two-sided 95% interval

justification.1_precedent: Every existing gate in this project computes its lower bound as the 2.5th percentile and calls it LCB95: experiments/analyze_k2_behavior_gate.py (100*alpha/2 with alpha=0.05), experiments/run_o1_gates.py ([2.5, 97.5]), experiments/o1_rollout.py ([2.5, 97.5]). Using a different convention for C3 alone would make gates across the project non-comparable.
justification.2_conservatism: q_0.025 is the stricter of the two readings. Resolving an ambiguity in the direction that makes passing HARDER cannot be a way of engineering a pass.
justification.3_direction_of_resolution_recorded: Stated explicitly so a later reader can confirm the ambiguity was not resolved opportunistically.

unchanged.weights: W_h = N_h / N from the COMPLETE Stage-1 census
unchanged.all_scientific_cells: T_trace 40, H_response 30, delta 0.10, U carrier_survival, pressure predicate, earliest-fork rule, exhaustive legal-response enumeration

decision_rule_fully_resolved: C3_PASS iff q_0.025(bootstrap of weighted natural fork_rate) > 0.20
immutability: This definition may not change after any sampled Stage-3 outcome is observed.
